title: Principles of Economics I
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the direct opposite of price ceiling."
Price Floor Price floor is the direct opposite of price ceiling.

Wealth is regarded not as an end in itself but a means to an end because it is use for human welfare.

Substitution effect is the effect of a change in price on quantity demanded as a result of switching by consumers to alternative or from alternative products.

The area labeled E is the excess demand or shortage which the market supply cannot take care of.

Utility is defined as the satisfaction or rewards derivable from consumption of a particular good or services relative to its alternatives.

Excess demand is defined as market condition that exists when quantity demanded exceeds quantity supplied at the current market price.

Principle of marginal utility is concerned with the fall in additional utility derived from consuming extra unit of a commodity.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to a shift in the demand curve."
change in demand refers to a shift in the demand curve.

An isoquant is a concave-shaped curve on a graph that measures output, and the trade-off between two factors needed to keep that output constant.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as the difference in an otherwise homogeneous product that occurs because of the time at which the product will be available for delivery."
Time utility is defined as the difference in an otherwise homogeneous product that occurs because of the time at which the product will be available for delivery.

Households in various places are the consumer of firms' commodity; they therefore behave in a predictable habitual pattern such that increases in prices of commodity are responded to by the consumer.

The input refers to all the factors of production such as land, labor, capital and entrepreneur.

Outputs are the end products produced by certain number of inputs combined under different methods of production given available technology.

Marshall state economics is the science of material welfare.

Land market is a factor market where land and other tangible assets are supply to firms and in return households obtain rent as rewards.

Transportation is the most common way to change the place utility of a product.

The quantity demanded (qD) is a function of five factors-price, buyer income, the price of related goods, consumer tastes, and any consumer expectations of future supply and price.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as the rate at which a consumer is willing to substitute one good for the other."
Marginal Rate of Substitution (MRS) is defined as the rate at which a consumer is willing to substitute one good for the other.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the reward to an entrepreneur."
Profit is the reward to an entrepreneur.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to a science which is based on data and facts."
Positive Economics refers to a science which is based on data and facts.

Wages and rents are the rewards for households while money paid for goods and services and skill of labor are rewards to the firms.

Demand refers to the quantity of a commodity the customer is willing and capable to purchase, at any given time and at each possible price.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the market price at which the quantity of a product demanded is equal to its quantity supplied."
Equilibrium price (EP) refers to the market price at which the quantity of a product demanded is equal to its quantity supplied.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the 'sellers' while households and government are the 'buyers' Sellers and buyers exchange goods and services for money in a place called 'market'."
Firms are the 'sellers' while households and government are the 'buyers' Sellers and buyers exchange goods and services for money in a place called 'market'.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the opposite of excess demand."
Excess supply is the opposite of excess demand.

Price elasticity of supply is defined as the responsiveness of quantity supplied to a change in price.

Supply and demand are the two sides of the market which makes market mechanism work through the price determination.

Cross elasticity Cross elasticity of demand is used to measure the percentage change in quantity demanded of one product when there is a change in the price of another close product.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the point at which there no more natural tendency for further adjustment."
Equilibrium point is the point at which there no more natural tendency for further adjustment.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the forces of demand and supply which determines the quantity of goods and services as well as their prices."
Market force is the forces of demand and supply which determines the quantity of goods and services as well as their prices.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an economic theory that assumes rational behavior on the part of individuals."
Rational choice theory is an economic theory that assumes rational behavior on the part of individuals.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to all features of a market that affect the behavior and performance of firms (and consumers) in that market."
Market structure refers to all features of a market that affect the behavior and performance of firms (and consumers) in that market.
